name: Mei Shaonian Meng Gongchang 3 - Chongsheng
source: The story continues after Braveness. It follows the storyline where Dean become Emperor of Three Realms, the kid you raised become the Human King. In this game, you are a teacher and the caretaker of the Deity kid. It seems that he has double personality.
